title: Queries unaffected by replacing an unavailable coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\Omega$ and $\alpha$ be types, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree with available-coordinate set $A\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Given an input $x:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\Omega$, a coordinate $j\notin A$, a value $\omega\in\Omega$, and any coordinate $i$, the query trace of $T$ on the input obtained by replacing $x(j)$ with $\omega$ contains $i$ if and only if its query trace on $x$ contains $i$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite decision tree with available-coordinate set $A$
